title: ThinkMorph-SSL: Scaling Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning with Pretext Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.32183v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: People reason with pictures as well as words. Interleaved multimodal reasoning gives models a similar way to solve problems by creating intermediate images and using them to guide further reasoning. Training models with this ability usually relies on task-specific demonstrations, which are difficult to collect. We introduce ThinkMorph-SSL, a two-stage training recipe that uses images themselves as a source of supervision. The first stage, pretext reasoning, converts visual pretext tasks, such as image colorization and denoising, into instruction-free interleaved traces. Models describe a corrupted or transformed image, generate a restored or canonical image, and interpret the result. The second stage uses automatically constructed demonstrations for question-driven instruction tuning. At the same instruction-tuning budget, models trained with pretext reasoning outperform those trained with instruction tuning alone. The full recipe impr

translated_title: ThinkMorph-SSL：利用前置任务扩展交错式多模态推理
translated_abstract: 人们不仅用文字，也用图像进行推理。交错式多模态推理让模型能够以类似的方式解决问题：通过生成中间图像，并将其用于指导后续推理。训练具备这种能力的模型通常依赖于针对特定任务的示范数据，而这些数据难以收集。我们提出了 ThinkMorph-SSL，这是一种两阶段训练方案，它将图像本身作为监督信号的来源。第一阶段为前置推理，将视觉前置任务（如图像上色和去噪）转换为无需指令的交错式推理轨迹：模型先描述一张受损或经过变换的图像，再生成恢复或规范化后的图像，并对结果进行解读。第二阶段则使用自动构建的示范数据进行问题驱动的指令微调。在相同的指令微调预算下，经过前置推理训练的模型优于仅使用指令微调训练的模型。完整的训练方案实现了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ThinkMorph-SSL 提出一种两阶段自监督训练方案，将图像上色、去噪等视觉前置任务转化为无需指令的交错式多模态推理轨迹，让图像本身充当监督信号，从而在相同指令微调预算下超越仅靠指令微调的模型。
en_tdlr: ThinkMorph-SSL is a two-stage training recipe that converts visual pretext tasks such as colorization and denoising into instruction-free interleaved reasoning traces, using images themselves as supervision and outperforming instruction tuning alone at the same tuning budget.
